messages.name: Dunder Mifflin admin
messages.body: We see HTTP 422 with code IP-4220 when we push invoices from our ERP. Is your API down?

messages.name: Priya (Support)
messages.body: IP-4220 means validation failed, and the message tells you which field. It is not retryable: fix the data (here, a quantity of 0) and send it again. If you want more detail, newer responses may include a subcode like IP-4221 for line item problems.
